title: Transistor defect inspection
description: Unsupervised defect detection for transistor inspection using PatchCore with a WideResNet50 backbone, with anomaly heatmaps for image-level classification and pixel-level defect localization.
alt: Abstract cover illustration for the transistor defect inspection project.
outcome: Anomaly detection and localization in images
demoAlt: Animated laptop screen recording showing transistor defect inspection and anomaly localization.

title: COPD severity assessment
description: Developed a ResNet-50 model to classify COPD severity into five categories (COPD0–COPD4) using lung sound spectrograms, aiming for faster assessment than conventional spirometry.
alt: Abstract cover illustration for the COPD severity assessment project.
outcome: Achieved 94.57% accuracy in COPD severity classification
demoAlt: laptop screen recording showing COPD severity assessment
